selection: All three publicly linked variants of the one bank statement, chosen before inference. All share one identity and remain in DEV. No TEST access.
input: Raster PDF page; poa --flat --words with shipped page detector and tagger. No camera, page detection or capture robustness claim.

mapping.account_number: personal_data entry of type ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED; full printed masked value, not last-four alone

normalisation: Unicode NFKC, casefold, replace nonalphanumeric characters with spaces, collapse whitespace. Dates must match ISO strings. No fuzzy matching, abbreviation expansion or ZIP truncation.

unscored.document_date: Publisher supplies only statement period, no independent issue date. Report missing/period-start/period-end/other categories only. Never infer truth from scanner output.
unscored.address.province: US state has no representation in shipped South African province enum; report as schema gap, never map state to province.

denominator: Three fixed inputs per method, nine field opportunities per input; missing/error/timeout/malformed results fail every field and all-fields. No exclusions after inference. One identity, so no statistical significance or population claims.

verification.entrypoint: Shipped poa_capture --max-frames=1 --min-frames=1, with each page's frozen OCR words independently; no cross-variant voting.
verification.matching: Known customer from independent publisher truth; age reference today. Acceptance diagnostic only, since US document is outside ZA postal domain and watermark is not an authenticity test.
verification.wrong_person: Replace customer name with fixed invented completely different name; preserve address.
verification.wrong_address: Add 1000 to leading house number in customer street; preserve name and all other address components.
verification.old: Same unedited image and customer, change reference clock to old_today, after period is more than three months old.
verification.failure: Failed OCR or verification process stays in denominator and never earns a successful rejection. Report reason checks and paired matching-accept plus negative-reject, to reveal trivial reject-all behavior.
verification.issuer_decoy: Not measured: no separately annotated issuer address in this sample.

diagnostic: Run clean PDF native text-layer words and original geometry through poa_fields and single-frame poa_capture; independent of image OCR and never pooled with image metrics. Same nine-field truth. This is a text-layer diagnostic, not oracle-quality OCR or end-to-end performance.
next_source: InvoiceOCR-Synth dataset card declares synthetic CC BY 4.0 and 177 utility_bill template records, but no images downloaded this round; templates are not proof of document semantic class.
limits: Single US fictional identity, one template, three correlated variants; no training, no SOTA claim, no real-document or South African deployment acceptance claim.
